= prepared-code(1)
:doctype: manpage
:revdate: 2026-10-02
:source-highlighter: syntect
:name: Early
:bold: pass:q[*Bold*]
:frozen: pass:a,q[*{name}*]
:normal: pass:normal[*{name}* (C)]
:link: pass:m[https://example.org[Site]]
:term: pass:m[((Term))]
:note: pass:m[footnote:n[Note body.]]
:alias: {bold} / {note}
:acdc-index:

== NAME

prepared-code - formatted attributes in code

== SYNOPSIS

*prepared-code*

== DESCRIPTION

:name: Late

[subs="specialchars,attributes"]
----
Formatting: {bold} / {frozen} / {normal} / {link}
Literal references: \{bold} / {bold\}
----

[subs="attributes,specialchars"]
----
Escaped: {bold} / {frozen} / {normal} / {link}
----

[subs="attributes"]
----
Macros: {alias} / {note} / {term}
----

[source,rust,subs="specialchars,attributes"]
----
// Highlighted: {alias} / {link} / {term}
----
